name: Thought Weaver
tactics: A thought weaver is nearly motionless in combat. Subtle movements of its arms and hands result in the eyes of an enemy glazing over as he swings at his nearby ally. The rare thought weaver that accompanies a raiding party coordinates its allies’ escape once the raid is complete.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Multitasking Brain
traits.details: While dazed, the thought weaver can spend a standard action and a minor action instead of only a standard action, and it can still take immediate actions.

traits.name: Coordinated Strike
traits.details: Once per round during its turn, the weaver can spend a standard action, a move action, or a minor action to allow one ally within 5 squares of it to immediately use an action of the same type as a free action.

effect.description: One creature dominated by the weaver within 10 squares of it takes 2d6 + 10 psychic damage. In addition, the weaver slides the creature 5 squares. The creature then uses an at-will attack of the weaver’s choice against one of its allies of the weaver’s choice.

powers.name: Mental Puppet
powers.usageDetails: when no creature is dominated by this power

hit.description: The weaver slides the target 5 squares. The target then makes a basic attack against one of its allies of the weaver’s choice. In addition, the target is dominated (save ends).
psychic damage, the target takes a -2 penalty to all defenses until the end of the thought weaver’s next turn, and the thought weaver slides the target 3 squares.

powers.name: Extract Psionic Soul
powers.requirements: The weaver must be holding a chromatic disk.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one bloodied creature that has psionic powers

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is dazed (save ends).

powers.name: Guardian Puppet
powers.trigger: An enemy willingly leaves a square adjacent to a creature dominated by the weaver.

effect.description: The dominated creature makes a basic attack against the triggering enemy.
